text:
sasha: Heads-up — staging canary for payments-service chart bump 2.4.0 -> 2.5.0 started but deploy-bot is blocked on a chart mutex in eu-west. Do we: wait for the current promotion to finish (release window at 14:00 UTC) or force a staggered cutover across AZs?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary blocked by chart-lock:release-pipeline/3145 (reason: values-merge in progress). ETA unknown. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/helm-mutex-handling :warning:

ashley: :eyes: my vote is staggered cutover. If we force parallel, we risk double-migrations on the db-seed job. Can we split traffic by region and hold eu-west until 14:05?

pranav: Agree w/ staggered. Also we should avoid pinning the global chart in production unless we need to. Suggest: promote 2.5.0 to eu-north first (safe zone), verify metrics for 10m, then eu-west manually unlock.

jin: If we do manual unlock, pls open a short blurb for release notes that mentions the delayed eu-west promotion and reason (values overlay merge conflict). I'll draft the blurb once we confirm timing.

mollie: Quick note — the canary includes a sidecar image change (log-collector 1.7.0 -> 1.8.0) that has known ephemeral log path changes. We should keep canary traffic at 5% for the first 5m.

sasha: Plan being proposed: 1) promote 2.5.0 to eu-north now, 5% traffic for 5m, sanity check. 2) if OK, request manual unlock for eu-west and promote at 14:05, 5% for 10m then 50% then full. 3) assemble release notes entry and include rollback command. Anyone object?

ashley: lgtm. Also add the rollback command to notes:``` 
helm rollback payments-service 1 --namespace payments --kube-context prod-eu-west
```

pranav: Add an ops-safe unlock command in case deploy-bot fails:``` 
kubectl -n infra annotate helmrelease payments-service redwood/locked-by- - --overwrite
```(this is a noisy unblock, use with approval).

deploy-bot: NOTE: If manual unlock is issued, subsequent promotions will auto-claim the chart-lock for 3m. Monitor deploy-bot logs: /var/log/deploybot/locks.log

jin: I'll draft the release blurb now and push to the release-notes PR. Blurb: "Payments service chart 2.5.0: staged regional rollout. eu-north promoted first; eu-west delayed due to values merge. Watch logs for sidecar path warnings. Rollback cmd included."

mollie: I'll watch metrics and post a snapshot at +5m after eu-north promotion.

sasha: OK doing eu-north promote now. Ping here when manual unlock request is opened and I'll ack for docs assembly. :thumbsup:
